notes.title: Full release!!
notes.notes:
The wait is over! Orbital Cascade has officially left Early Access and is now fully released on Steam!

Thank you to everyone who supported the game during development, your feedback has been invaluable.

This last update includes:
✅ Achievements to challenge yourself and show off your skills
✅ Several bug fixes for a smoother experience
✅ Overall improvements for better gameplay


Join the community and share your high scores on Discord: Discord Server

See you in orbit! 🌌

notes.title: Big Update: New Level & Prepping to leave Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Exciting news, a brand new level, Squarantine, has just been added in the latest update!
It’s wild, it’s chaotic, and it’s probably going to confuse you (in the best way possible). Hope you’re ready for the challenge!

Introducing Squarantine – A Fusion of Chaos

[previewyoutube=Te2QQHSzHxo;full][/previewyoutube]


Squarantine is what happens when you take the mechanics of Hexogenesis and Hexanihilation, smash them together, and hope for the best. It’s a fusion of both previous levels.

In this level, you’ll need to rotate and move your plane, just like in Hexanihilation, but now with an added layer of complexity from Hexogenesis.
The challenge? Adapting to both movement styles at once, balancing precision with quick decision-making. Expect unexpected twists, and a lot of "what just happened?" moments.

Leaving Early Access Next Week!
That’s right, next week, the game will officially be leaving Early Access! 🎉

With the full release, you can expect:

More achievements to unlock (because who doesn’t love achievements?).
Bug fixes to smooth out any lingering rough edges.
A huge thank you to everyone who played, gave feedback, and supported the game. Your enthusiasm has been incredible, and I couldn’t have done this without you!
Go check out Squarantine, and get ready for the full launch next week! 🚀

notes.title: Weekly cleanup
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This week was all about fixing bugs and preparing for the new level, which, if everything goes according to plan (and nothing catches fire), should be ready soon.

Speaking of progress, there’s now an achievement to unlock! 
That’s right, you can finally feel a sense of accomplishment, even if it’s just for blowing things up.

And don’t worry, a whole bunch more achievements are on the way for the final release at the end of the month. You’ll soon be drowning in digital trophies.

As for the new level, it’s coming along just fine, by which I mean it’s just as confusing as expected.
But that’s part of the fun, right?
Get ready for some "What am I even doing?" moments.

Stay tuned, and as always, thanks for playing!

notes.title: New Level: Hexanihilation
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

[previewyoutube=7Wph4p2VCio;full][/previewyoutube]


This update brings a brand new level, high scores, and lots of improvements to make the game feel even better. Here’s what’s new:

🚀 [b]New Content[/b]
Hexanihilation – A brand new level with a different gameplay twist! Unlike Hexogenesis, you can now move the plane!

🔧[b] Improvements & Fixes[/b]
Smoother Controls – The way the controller works has been improved to feel more responsive and intuitive.
UI Enhancements – The menus and interface have been cleaned up to be clearer and easier to use.
General bug fixes and optimizations to keep everything running smoothly.

🛣️ [b]The Road to Full Release (End of the Month!)[/b]
I’m working hard to get the game out of Early Access by the end of the month! Here’s what’s next:

Fixing any remaining bugs from this big update.
Adding a tutorial for Hexanihilation so everyone can get the hang of the new mechanics.
Implementing Steam Achievements.
Developing the third level.

Hope you enjoy the update! 
Let me know what you think, and as always, thanks for playing! 😊

notes.title: Smoother Controls, Better Saves & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 🚀

A new Friday update is here! This update focuses on smoother input handling and fixing pesky bugs to make the game feel even better.

🎮 Improved Controls & UI Fixes
Pause & Unpause Fixes: The pause menu is now more responsive and won’t lurk in the shadows when not in use.
Controller Fixes: No more clashing inputs—controls should feel much smoother!
🎨 Visual & Gameplay Fixes
Ring Colors Fixed: Rings now always match their expected colors.
Bomb Display Fixed: No more weird visuals—bombs should now appear correctly.
Controller Rotation Feels Better: Rotation now works based on left and right input instead of absolute positioning, making movement more intuitive.
I’ve also cleaned up some stuff behind the scenes!

BTW... The level name is now displayed. Does it mean something? Who knows... Stay tuned to find out! 👀

That’s it for now—let me know if you run into any issues, and as always, thanks for playing! 😃

notes.title: New Balls and Visual Improvements!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 🌌

I’m here to share the latest update for Orbital Cascade, and I’ve been working hard to make this release packed with new features, gameplay tweaks, and visual improvements. 


[previewyoutube=oFcESKlq7Dw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Here’s what’s new:

🎮 Gameplay Update: Two New Ball Types!
I’ve added two special balls to shake things up:

🌀 Black Hole Balls:

They match with any color, making them super versatile!
But here’s the catch—they’re tough to clear! Each Black Hole Ball has 1 to 4 HP and requires multiple explosions to remove.
🧱 Brick Balls:

These can’t be removed from the board and don’t contribute to any chains, they are actual bricks...  so you’ll have to plan your moves around them and good luck with that.
These new ball types add a new layer of strategy that I think you’ll enjoy figuring out!

🖼️ Other Updates and Improvements
Crispier Sprites: I’ve updated the visuals to give the game a sharper, more polished look.
Clearer Tutorial: I made some tweaks to the tutorial to help new players get into the game faster.
Minor Menu Fixes: Cleaned up some menu behavior to make navigation smoother.
I hope you enjoy these updates as much as I enjoyed creating them! As always, I’d love to hear your feedback, so feel free to drop a comment or message me with your thoughts.

Thanks so much for your support—it means the world to me!

Happy cascading! 🚀

notes.title: Controller support is here!
notes.notes:
I’m thrilled to share the latest update for the game, 0.12.1.30.beta, with few new features and quality-of-life improvements.

Here’s what’s new:

Edge Explosions: You can now explode balls on the edge of the board! This adds a new layer of strategy and fun to gameplay! Test it out and see how it changes your approach.
Improved Tutorial: A clearer, more detailed tutorial has been added to help new players jump in with confidence and get the most out of the game, let me know your feedback on this.
Controller Support: I’ve introduced controller mode, optimized for Xbox-style controllers. Whether you’re a fan of gamepads or just want a break from the mouse, this new option will enhance your gameplay experience.
Polish and Fixes: Various minor improvements and stability fixes have been implemented to keep everything running smoothly.
I’m constantly working to improve the game, and your feedback plays a huge part in shaping these updates. Let me know how you like the new changes—especially the edge explosions and controller mode!

Thanks for playing, and have fun experimenting with all the new features! 🎮✨
